title: Less is more: Probabilistic reduction is best explained by small-scale predictability measures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the predictive power of language models on phonetic duration (probabilistic reduction) across different speech communities. The authors compare model performance on corpora representing White Mainstream American English (WMAE) and African American Language (AAL). To mitigate the bias of superimposing dominant linguistic statistics onto marginalized varieties, they fine-tune models separately on specific dialect corpora and analyze the differences in predictive accuracy.
